children: Meme coin launch platforms are still recording about $550 million in daily trading volume, according to crypto analyst Drallio. According to Odaily, this is significantly higher than levels seen a few months ago.

Statistical data showed that daily trading volume on meme coin launch platforms was about $200 million in mid-July and briefly exceeded $1.8 billion in early September. Although activity has eased recently, it remains well above July levels.

title: Meme Coin Launch Platforms Maintain $550 Million in Daily Trading Volume
